title: Ivory.Meadow.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: Plain split-file parts named test-media.mkv.001/.002/.003 with a PAR2 set computed over the joined file rather than over the parts, and three blocks zeroed inside the middle part. The recovery set names a file the posting never carries, so the parts have to be read as one file, repaired and joined exactly once: the delivered output is the joined MKV byte for byte, and the parts are not part of the release.
